jobs.title: Arena Event Security Specialist
jobs.description:
San Antonio Spurs Sports & Entertainment in San Antonio, TX, is seeking a Security Guard to protect Frost Bank Center and Toyota Field. You will regulate access, respond to alarms, assist guests, and enforce safety policies during games and events.

Candidates should have a High School Diploma and a valid Level 2 Security License, plus the ability to work long hours including evenings and weekends. Training in security procedures and clear communication are essential.

jobs.description:
Spurs Sports & Entertainment (SS&E) is seeking a full-time security guard to help protect the Frost Bank Center, Toyota Field, and surrounding grounds in San Antonio, TX. You will monitor access, respond to alarms, and maintain a safe environment for guests, employees, and vendors.

This role requires a High School Diploma, a Level 2 Security License, willingness to work flexible hours including nights and weekends, and strong communication.
